text: Deutoplasm [Gr. denteroV , second, + plasma , substance]: Ger. Nahrungsdotter ; Fr. deutoplasme , lécithe ; Ital. deutoplasma . That portion of the egg which affords nourishment to the formative protoplasm; commonly called the yolk. Proposed by Van Beneden (1870). ( C.LL.M. )
